content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Allahabad University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at Allahabad University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at Allahabad University is 27-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class M.E./ M.Tech./B. Tech/M.Sc. in ECE/EIE/Material Science/Nanotechnology/Physics or equivalent allied subjects with specific marks for different categories. GATE/CSIR/UGC NET qualification is desired.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 32 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will the selection be made for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA for the third year.

faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post at Allahabad University.
